messages:
Theo: opened PR to tighten the Quickstart sample app: switch to unified SDK init, normalize env var name, and trim Dockerfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2650. Can @Rina review?
Rina: quick look 1: agree SDK-first. Keep one-line curl as an advanced smoke check. Also update the Python import to `from redwood import RedwoodClient`.
Theo: updated py snippet and JS snippet to use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Added a tiny migration note mapping `REDWOOD_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
DocsBot: /docs/lint 1 warning: code fence missing language in one snippet.
Theo: fixed fences (```javascript and ```python) and shortened the sample prompt to "Write a friendly greeting" so smoke tests are stable. Pushed commit 0b9d.
Rina: small nit: remove explicit `--platform` from Dockerfile, mention advanced builds in a side-note. Also add troubleshooting blurb: "401? confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and not expired."
QA: Can we include an npm smoke script for CI? a single `npm run smoke` that hits the sample generate call is helpful.
Theo: added `smoke` script and a minimal smoke.js example. CI lint re-run queued.
DocsBot: /docs/lint 1 all checks passed.
Rina: LGTM, approving. Merge when CI green.
Theo: thanks all 1 will cherry-pick the migration blurb into the migration guide after merge. :rocket:
